clips.title: The story
paras: Burning Blade cultists in Durotar carry reagents for a shaman's first fire sapta. Telf Joolam uses them with fire tar from Razormane quilboar to make the draught that lets a young shaman see the realm of fire.

Burning Blade cultists carry reagents for a young shaman's first fire sapta. The hermit Telf Joolam uses the powders and oils in their pouches with fire tar from Razormane quilboar. Together, these components make a draught that grants sight into the realm of fire and attunes the shaman to the spirits of flame.

Burning Blade cultists turn flame toward destruction and fel sorcery, yet the elements in their pouches still belong to heat and combustion. Shaman teach that elemental forces exist in tension: fire creates as well as destroys. A shaman can take the cultists' tools and use those elements to awaken true communion with the spirits.
